scope: Current Messages Files HTTP client and metadata validation; canonical adapter activation follows with the file-store integration.
coverage: Real loopback HTTP paths, case-insensitive header replacement, fixed version/beta and multipart fields
Messages metadata including safe integer bytes, V8 date parsing, null/empty cursors and requested upload expiry
Deletion markers, invalid JSON, gzip, status classification and forbidden redirect without a target request
Pre-aborted reason identity; task cancellation joins the owned reader and detaches signal listeners
limits: Local server origins are verified structurally and normalized in transport error messages
Codec-independent gzip is covered; Brotli and arbitrary malformed request-header diagnostics are not qualified
Body transport exception classes remain those of the native HTTP runtime
Targeted completion does not establish full application or release acceptance
